name: flint-chart-plugin
description: Pick the right chart for the data and question, then render it locally via the microsoft/flint-chart MCP server. Combines a framing skill (Big Idea + story arc + audience + TRADITIONAL vs INNOVATIVE style stance) with a chart-selection + rendering skill (Comparison / Trend / Distribution / Relationship / Proportion / Flow / KPI) and a /render-chart prompt. Renders Vega-Lite / ECharts / Chart.js locally — no data leaves the machine.

requires_runtime.notes: The bundled mcp.json invokes `npx -y flint-chart-mcp@^0.2.2` on first tool call; Node 22+ required. First cold start ~1-2s; cached thereafter. Install it to `.vscode/mcp.json` — VS Code does NOT read a workspace-root `.mcp.json`, which is the Claude Code convention; the `servers` schema is identical, and VS Code reports no error because it reads no file at all. The ^0.2.2 pin is held deliberately: caret on 0.x means >=0.2.2 <0.3.0, and although public npm `latest` is 0.4.0, that version is unreachable from Microsoft corporate npm mirrors, which stop at 0.2.2.

upstream.notes: Source-of-truth is the upstream OSS repo. Mall vendors a specific version; when upstream tags a new release, Mall automation flags the mismatch.

mcp.notes: VS Code workspace path is `.vscode/mcp.json`. Root `.mcp.json` is the Claude Code convention and is never read by VS Code; Cursor uses `.cursor/mcp.json`. Merge the `flint` entry under `servers`.

install_notes: Skills and prompts install under `local/`, which VS Code does not discover by default. Alex ACT Edition heirs (>=3.0.0, per requires_edition) already register those roots, so no extra settings are needed for a Mall install. On a plain VS Code workspace, `chat.agentSkillsLocations` and `chat.promptFilesLocations` must additionally point at `.github/skills/local` and `.github/prompts/local` — see the upstream README.

attribution.role: invoked via npx on first tool call

schema_notes: First Mall plugin with an MCP artifact. Shape code retained as .SP. (skill + prompt) since the current 4-position shape [I][S][P][M=muscle] does not have an MCP position. If Mall extends shape to 5 positions for MCP, bump this plugin to `.SPM.` (or agreed-upon convention).
